events.name: National Ranking Table Tennis Championships 2026 (Uttarakhand)
events.venue: New Multipurpose Hall, Parade Ground, Dehradun
events.organiser: Uttarakhand Table Tennis Association under the Table Tennis Federation of India (TTFI)
events.registration_notes: Entries only through a state association (noon 17 October) or institution (noon 15 October) on the TTFI online system; individuals cannot enter directly. Players must hold 2026 TTFI registration (Rs 500 per year). TTFI's government recognition was suspended in August 2026, but ranking events have continued.
events.summary: Eight-day national ranking (zonal) championship on the TTFI 2026-27 domestic circuit, with men's and women's singles plus boys' and girls' singles from U-11 to U-19. It awards national ranking points and runs in the 31 October to 7 November slot that the TTFI calendar had first listed for Pondicherry.

categories.name: Men's Singles
categories.eligibility: TTFI-registered player entered by a state association or institution
categories.notes: Rs 1,000 per entry for a state's first five entries; additional entries Rs 3,700.

categories.name: Women's Singles
categories.eligibility: TTFI-registered player entered by a state association or institution
categories.notes: Rs 1,000 per entry for a state's first five entries; additional entries Rs 3,700.

categories.name: Youth Singles U-19 and U-17 (boys and girls)
categories.eligibility: U-19: born on or after 1 Jan 2008. U-17: born on or after 1 Jan 2010.
categories.notes: Rs 900 for a state's first four entries per event; additional entries Rs 3,700.

categories.name: Youth Singles U-15 and U-13 (boys and girls)
categories.eligibility: U-15: born on or after 1 Jan 2012. U-13: born on or after 1 Jan 2014.
categories.notes: Rs 800 for a state's first four entries per event; additional entries Rs 2,700.

categories.name: Youth Singles U-11 (boys and girls)
categories.notes: Rs 700 for a state's first four entries; additional entries Rs 1,700.

course.surface: Stag Roma tables, Stag Global 3-star 40+ balls
course.description: Indoor multipurpose hall at Parade Ground in central Dehradun.

events.format: Qualification stage followed by knockout main draws (men's and women's main draws from round of 256). Tentative schedule: U-11 and U-13 from 31 October, men's and women's singles main draw 5 to 7 November. Ranking points awarded per TTFI guidelines.
highlights: Part of the TTFI national ranking circuit
11 singles events from U-11 to senior
tips: Talk to your state association before 17 October; it controls entries and fees
Players arrange their own boarding and lodging
Withdrawals after noon on 30 October cost 20 ranking points
Youth players should carry an original birth certificate and Aadhaar copy

events.name: National Ranking Table Tennis Championships 2026 (Punjab)
events.venue: Lovely Professional University, Jalandhar-Delhi GT Road, Phagwara
events.organiser: Punjab Table Tennis Association with Lovely Professional University, under TTFI
events.registration_notes: Entries only through a state association (noon 31 October) or institution (noon 29 October) on the TTFI online system. Players must hold 2026 TTFI registration (Rs 500 per year).
events.summary: Eight-day national ranking championship on the TTFI 2026-27 circuit at LPU, Phagwara, about 40 km from Ludhiana. It starts with men's and women's singles and runs through youth events down to U-11. Total prize money is Rs 9,99,400.

categories.name: Men's Singles
categories.eligibility: TTFI-registered player entered by a state association or institution
categories.notes: Rs 1,000 per entry for a state's first five entries; additional entries Rs 3,700.

categories.name: Women's Singles
categories.eligibility: TTFI-registered player entered by a state association or institution
categories.notes: Rs 1,000 per entry for a state's first five entries; additional entries Rs 3,700.

categories.name: Youth Singles U-19 and U-17 (boys and girls)
categories.eligibility: Age cut-offs as per TTFI 2026 rules (U-19 born on or after 1 Jan 2008)
categories.notes: Rs 900 for a state's first four entries per event; additional entries Rs 3,700.

categories.name: Youth Singles U-15, U-13 and U-11 (boys and girls)
categories.eligibility: Age cut-offs as per TTFI 2026 rules
categories.notes: Rs 800 for U-15 and U-13, Rs 700 for U-11 (first four state entries); additional entries Rs 2,700 (U-15/U-13) or Rs 1,700 (U-11).

course.description: LPU campus on the Jalandhar-Delhi GT Road at Phagwara, between Jalandhar and Ludhiana.

events.format: Qualification stage then knockout main draws. Tentative schedule: men's and women's singles qualifying 14 November, through to finals 17 November; youth events 17 to 21 November. Ranking points per TTFI guidelines.
highlights: Senior events played first, so adult players finish within four days
tips: Senior draw is made at 11 AM on 13 November at the venue; plan to arrive the day before
Jalandhar City and Phagwara railway stations are the closest rail links
Mid-November nights are cool in Punjab; bring warm-up layers

events.name: National Masters Table Tennis Championships
events.organiser: Table Tennis Federation of India (host association to be confirmed)
events.registration_notes: Dates and city are from the TTFI 2026 tournament calendar; the prospectus is not yet published and other 2026 calendar events have moved venue. TTFI keeps a separate veteran player register.
events.summary: TTFI's national championship for masters (veteran) players, listed on the federation's 2026 calendar for 14-21 February 2027 in Jaipur. The previous edition was held at Balewadi Sports Stadium, Pune, from 24 April 2026.

categories.name: Masters age-group events
categories.eligibility: Players on TTFI's veteran player register, entered through their state association or institution
categories.notes: Age bands and fees will be in the prospectus.

course.description: Venue in Jaipur not yet announced.

events.format: Age-group championships for veterans; draw format to be set in the prospectus.
highlights: National title event for veteran players
tips: Check that you appear on the TTFI veteran player list (ttfi.org/veterans) before entries open
Wait for the prospectus before booking; TTFI calendar venues have changed during 2026
February is peak tourist season in Jaipur, so book rooms early

events.name: IFCCI Chennai Sports Tournament (table tennis)
events.venue: Loyola-ICAM College of Engineering and Technology, Loyola Campus, Nungambakkam
events.organiser: Indo-French Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IFCCI)
events.registration_notes: Prior registration mandatory, slots first-come first-served. The 2026 listing gives both 6 March and 13 March, so confirm the date.
events.summary: One-day multi-sport corporate tournament run by the Indo-French Chamber in Chennai, with table tennis doubles alongside 5 v 5 football, throwball, cricket and badminton. The 6th edition was held in March 2026 at the Loyola campus in Nungambakkam.

categories.name: Table Tennis Doubles (men's, women's or mixed)
categories.notes: Fee per pair (2026). Single entry Rs 2,000.

course.description: College campus in Nungambakkam, central Chennai.

events.format: Doubles; pairs can be all-men, all-women or mixed. One-day event, 7 AM to 4 PM. Draw format not published.
highlights: Same event offers 5 v 5 football at Rs 10,000 per team (6 players)
tips: Slots fill first-come first-served; register in January
March in Chennai is already hot; carry water and a spare shirt
